description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for inserting and editing checkbox elements within the editor. It includes dialog configuration, event handlers for showing and confirming dialog data, and setup and commit functions for dialog fields related to checkbox attributes.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the dialog is shown; it initializes checkbox element for editing if a checkbox is selected.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the dialog is confirmed; it creates a new checkbox element with specified attributes if not editing an existing one.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Function to initialize dialog fields based on the selected element's attributes.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Function to save dialog input back to the element's attributes.
